JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a lightweight data-interchange format heavily used in web development and APIs. CSV (Comma Separated Values) is a simpler format widely used by spreadsheet applications like Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and data science tools.

Yes! Once you click "Download CSV", you can open the resulting `.csv` file directly in Microsoft Excel, Apple Numbers, Google Sheets, or LibreOffice Calc. If your data contains special characters, ensure you import it using UTF-8 encoding in Excel.

**Is it safe to convert private API data here?**
